text:
anna: Quick sync — post-RFC followup: we need a concise rollout safety checklist for the kernel/attention optimizations. Who can draft gating + fallback rules?

mike: I can. Drafting a short checklist now. TL;DR: per-model enable flags, global kill-switch, automatic fallback to `kernel-v1` on errors/latency, staged canary by traffic slice, and operator runbook.

kai: Please include KV cache warmup and cache-hit regression as first-class signals. If cache-hit drops >10% and p95 latency increases, that should trigger rollback.

sarah: Need a simple ops command for manual rollback that oncall can run quickly.

mike: + config + commands draft below. Feedback welcome.

```bash
# enable 10% canary for specific models
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --flag attention_opt_v2 --models "llama-2-7b,redwood/*" --percent 10

# promote to 50%
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --flag attention_opt_v2 --percent 50

# full rollback (global kill switch)
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --flag attention_opt_v2 --off
```

mike: And a compact per-model policy snippet (for the config repo):

```json
{
  "flags": [
    {
      "name": "attention_opt_v2",
      "models": ["llama-2-7b","redwood/*"],
      "default": false,
      "canary_percent": 10
    }
  ],
  "fallback_policy": "fallback-to-kernel-v1-on-error-or-latency",
  "safeguard": {"p95_latency_pct_increase": 20, "error_rate_pct": 0.5, "kv_cache_drop_pct": 10}
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for `attention_opt_v2` canary 10% -> shard us-west-1 (build 2026.09.14-rc3) :rocket:

mike: Monitoring checklist (dashboards & alerts):
- p50 / p95 token latency by model and kernel
- request error rate (5m window)
- KV cache hit rate and warmup curve
- token throughput and token drop / truncation events
- OOM and process restarts
- tail latency spikes (99th)

sarah: Suggested alert thresholds: p95 latency > baseline * 1.2 for 5m, error rate > 0.5% for 5m, KV cache hit drop > 10% vs baseline for 10m. All fire an escalation to @oncall and a runbook link.

kai: Runbook steps (short):
1) Pause canary: `redwoodctl feature-toggle set --flag attention_opt_v2 --percent 0`
2) Trigger fallback for affected model(s): `redwoodctl runtime fallback --model llama-2-7b --to kernel-v1`
3) Recompute routing & warm caches for kernel-v1 (pre-warm prefix cache)
4) Open incident in PagerDuty and tag the rollout PR

anna: Add a manual smoke test checklist too (sample prompts + expected latency band + token counts). Also require perf-harness validation pre-canary.

mike: Gate mechanics summary:
- Unit + perf tests pass in CI (perf harness regression <3% p95)
- Staging integration with real KV cache + synthetic traffic
- Canary: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30-60m observation windows
- Auto-fallback: immediate if error_rate > threshold OR p95 > threshold OR OOMs seen

oncall: tagging to say we have the runbook and dashboard links. Please DM if we get alerts overnight.

kai: I'll update the RFC tracker with this checklist and create the dashboard tiles for cache-hit, kernel-switch failures, and rollout percent.

anna: Perfect. I'll slot a short ops dry-run next week and we'll close the post-RFC action item. :thumbsup:
